title: Kul Tiran Admiralty
wikitext:
[[File:Anchor's Edge ship.png|thumb|300x300px]]The page refers to the <Kul Tiran Admiralty> former Kul Tiran Navy Roleplay and low lvl PVP guild in the Nordanaar server. We host Roleplay events and in between some of us try to fill the lowl lvl Battleground brackets. One does not need to be part of both activity, in order to join. However between roleplaying sessions one can go to Battlegrounds, and the grind is not that painful, when we spice the Kul Tiran story with roleplaying. Please note roleplay and PVP events are separated, we don't really mix the two activity.

Regarding PVP, we collect alliance players between 1-49 on our discord. The goal is to have as much low lvl WSG/AB as possible. We run weekly PVP hours for each battleground bracket and there are voice channels to use on our discord. Now back to Roleplay:

The Kul Tiran Navy is serving the High Admiral, at all times. Representing interests of Kul Tiras in every corner of the world. Roleplaying adventures and members you will find under: [https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=15880 Logbook of the Kul Tiran Admiralty]
[[File:Kul Tiran patrol.webp|thumb|Kul Tiran landing]]
'''One can find us in several places:''' 

* in Davenburg a part of Stormwind where they maintain an embassy.
* in the Lapidis Island where Admiral Caelan's  fleet is wrecked.
* at Anchor's Edge and Tiragarde Keep where the Kul Tirans maintaining their offensive on Durotar.

The guild is exchanging with other factions, does some town rp, some scavenger hunt and occasionally have some corner for those people who are interested in low lvl PVP.

The members may come from different races of the Alliance, but they all swear fealty to the Kul Tiran state. They will be paid soldiers of the Navy after joining.[[File:Navy Crew.png|The watch|thumb|353x353px]]'''Races we welcome:''' 

* Mostly Human
* Dwarfs
* Gnomes
* High Elf -  ''with explanation, why to work for the Navy'' 
* Night Elf - ''with explanation, why to work for the Navy''
[[File:Tiragarde_guards.png|thumb|314x314px]]'''Roles we need in the Navy:'''
* Sailors
* Cooks
* Bartenders
* Guards, Marines
* Hyromancers
* Priests of the Holy light
* Treasure hunters
* Lumberjacks
* Brewers
* Hunters
* Cannoners


'''How to join?'''

Please find us at the Turtle WoW discord and connect us there, or find us in the game! 

Selewkos, Reijo 

Let's write together our future!

[[File:Armada.png|thumb|400x400px]]''"Join the Kul Tiran Admiralty, where the sea is your home and honor is your compass. As a recruit, you'll learn the art of seamanship from seasoned sailors in Davensburg, mastering the rigging and weaponry of our mighty warships. From defending our shores to exploring distant horizons, your journey will be steeped in adventure and camaraderie. Embrace the call of the sea, and become part of a legacy that spans generations. Are you ready to sail with courage and uphold the proud traditions of Kul Tiras? Join us, and together, we will face the challenges of the Great Sea with unwavering resolve."''<gallery>
